chapter_seo_title: Intelligence: Li Huowang Joins the Supervisory Heavenly Office
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang bribes his way into the Supervisory Heavenly Office and receives classified intel on the terrifying, mahjong-obsessed Zuowandao. The test begins now.
og_title: Chapter 284 – Intelligence: The Big-Headed Doll Knows
og_description: Bribes, mahjong, and a creepy HR rep. Li Huowang’s first day at the Supervisory Heavenly Office is a masterclass in quiet, bureaucratic horror.
twitter_title: Li Huowang’s worst on-the-job training yet
twitter_description: Chapter 284 reveals the secrets of the Zuowandao and proves that even celestial offices require a little palm-greasing.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient Chinese cycle of ten characters used in calendars and ranking; “Gui” (癸) is the last and lowest rank, which Li Huowang gets assigned in the celestial hierarchy.
A form of condensed life span used as currency for supernatural rewards; Li Huowang uses them as a bribe to enter the Supervisory Heavenly Office.
A traditional Chinese folk-art doll; in the Dao-Twisted World, it is used as a disguise by a member of the Supervisory Heavenly Office, lending an uncanny, half-childlike quality to the encounter.
A low-ranking position in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; “Gui” from the Heavenly Stems indicates junior status, and “Zu” suggests a foot-soldier or runner.
The Zuowandao’s internal hierarchy mimics the suits and honor tiles of mahjong; the fictional “Dice” (骰子) is rumored to control the entire sect.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Supervisory Heavenly Office (监天司)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A government-sponsored supernatural law enforcement body; they hunt rogue cultivators, manage cosmic disasters, and apparently require bribes to process new recruits.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Zuowandao use mahjong terms?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Their entire organization is built on the logic of deception and game-theory; mahjong is a game of strategy and luck, and the author weaponizes it as a symbol of their chaotic, self-amusing nature.
